notes.title: Tale of Alamar update!
notes.content: Join Hiro, Alotta, Rhaza, and Liri on a brand new adventure! Help your friend Felix Felicidades to prepare for the Royal wedding between Princess Cassandra of  Keizei and Prince Lucian of the Floating Isle of Magnes! See what goes wrong on this wacky wedding adventure that includes new monsters, new items, and new locations! Not only that, but monsters throughout the land of Alamar have been beefed up and given new A.I. and Skills. New items can be acquired at the Vitis Gift shop and other locations. These new additions bring even more life into these games.
